name: crossflow_hx_hot_gas_water
title: Crossflow heat exchanger - hot gas heating water (effectiveness-NTU)
summary: Crossflow heat exchanger using hot gas of constant specific heat to heat pressurised water, rated with the crossflow effectiveness-NTU method: capacity rates, NTU, effectiveness, transferred power, gas flow rate and required exchange area.

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file (CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip, EES_ok/exchangers2.EES, EES 9.920)
verification.notes: 28/29 variables within rtol=0.001 as printed by compare_solution.py; T_wall 1.04e-03 (0.3 K on -312 C, subtraction-amplified). All deviations trace to EES 9.920 vs CoolProp water cp at (2 bar, 80 C), 0.063 %. Curated .initials (EES stored values) required: without guesses the solver takes a degenerate root of the wall block.

related_external: CoolSolve examples/exchangers2.eescode (same model, kept in CoolSolve as a test case)
CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip: EES_ok/exchangers2.EES (original French EES file with stored solution)
